sloka: महाऋषि यः वसिष्ठः तु यः पितुः नः पुरोहितः ।अह्ना पुत्र शतम् जज्ञे तथैव अस्य पुनर् हतम् ॥३-६६-९॥
transliteration: mahāṛṣi yaḥ vasiṣṭhaḥ tu yaḥ pituḥ naḥ purohitaḥ ।ahnā putra śatam jajñe tathaiva asya punar hatam ॥3-66-9॥

translations.english: You (rigidly) adhere to truth.(Like you) the mother earth who is adored by all the worlds, is unshakeable. Yet she is seen to be shaking at times.
